sloka: शक्यम् त्वया अपि तत् कार्यम् धर्मम् एव अनुवर्तता ।श्रूयते मनुना गीतौ श्लोकौ चारित्र वत्सलौ।गृहीतौ धर्म कुशलैः तथा तत् चरितम् मयाअ ॥४-१८-३०॥
transliteration: śakyam tvayā api tat kāryam dharmam eva anuvartatā ।śrūyate manunā gītau ślokau cāritra vatsalau।gṛhītau dharma kuśalaiḥ tathā tat caritam mayāa ॥4-18-30॥

translations.english: 'You should also have acted in that manner considering dharma. Now listen to what Manu said, in two verses that hold good traditions dear which are accepted by men wellversed in dharma. O monkey the action taken by me is in conformity with this.
